plain_language: JX-3 asked whether generation 7 improved everywhere or only on the trajectories it kept anchoring on. The replay of the run's batch random stream matched every retained checkpoint's state, so the anchors are known: 40 distinct anchors over 951 steps. From step 0 to step 951 the IC loss changed by a median factor of 0.00517 on the 7 most-anchored training trajectories, 0.331 on 7 never-anchored ones and 0.274 on 6 validation ones; the residual sum changed by 0.369, 0.448 and 0.335. Reading: mixed: exposure-specific / global.

reading.question: Was generation 7's improvement global or specific to the trajectories it anchored on?
